Manifest.VersionInfoText:
RFiDGear 2.0.5.0
New: - Pre-quick-check key dialog: configure DESFire and MIFARE Classic keys before every quick check, with a "Do not ask again" option - Default Keys tab in Settings: edit and validate quick-check keys with live green/red feedback - "Check for Updates" now shows a confirmation when already on the latest version
Fixed: - AppExistCheck task incorrectly reported success even when the specified application ID did not exist on the card - DESFire WriteData returning false success; key settings not persisted after ChangeKey; PICC authentication retry logic - LibLogicalAccess: file access-rights byte order mismatch; missing file size in GetFileSettings; application list accumulating across repeated quick-check runs; DESFire key SWIG copy trap causing authentication failures - Elatec provider: COM port access now serialised to prevent concurrent-access errors - Settings window no longer grows to extreme width when many MIFARE Classic keys are loaded
